title: add fast_executemany deprecation to 2.0 changelog notes; investigate possible API mis-use when it's enabled w/ bulk (add tests?)

labels.name: great mcve
labels.description: An issue with a great mcve

labels.name: dialects
labels.description: general dialect tag. useful for unsupported dbs or deprecations. not needed for specific dbs.

body:
### Describe the bug

When using ``fast_executemany`` and doing effectively a bulk_insert t we get an error for 2.0.0b3. This works on the 1.4.x branch. 

It seems that this happens because it runs through ``do_execute`` instead of ``do_execute_many`` now. (not sure if this is a bug in pyodbc)

https://docs.sqlalchemy.org/en/20/changelog/whatsnew_20.html#optimized-orm-bulk-insert-now-implemented-for-all-backends-other-than-mysql

Is this expected in 2.0?

### To Reproduce

```python
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, MetaData, Column, Integer, Unicode

con_str = "mssql+pyodbc://your_connection_string"

meta = MetaData()
Base = declarative_base(metadata=meta)


class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "user"
    user_id = Column("user_id", Integer, primary_key=True)
    test = Column("test", Integer, nullable=False)
    user_name = Column("user_name", Unicode(50), nullable=False)


engine = create_engine(con_str, fast_executemany=True)
meta.create_all(engine)

data = [{"user_id": 1, "test": 1, "user_name": "a"}, {"user_id": 2, "test": 1, "user_name": 5}]

with Session(engine) as session:
    session.bulk_insert_mappings(User, data)
    session.commit()
```

### Versions

- OS: MacOs and Ubuntu
- Python: 3.10.5
- SQLAlchemy: 2.0.0b3
- Database: MS SQL 2019
- DBAPI (eg: psycopg, cx_oracle, mysqlclient): pyodbc


### Additional context

This errors too if using 2.0.0b3 syntax with 

```
with Session(engine) as session:
    session.execute(insert(User), data)
    session.commit()
```
